panels.title: Movie screen
panels.description: Single Postgres channel per player: **idle** rows use ``SOCIAL_MOVIE_PIXEL_IDLE_HEATMAP_MOVIE_ID`` (noise); **screening** rows use that title's ``movie_id`` (PNG sequence, ``movie_pixel_frame_index`` on ``bunker_social_state``). Grafana COALESCE picks which key to read. Greys scheme in panel options. Hidden ``social_movie_heatmap_history_seconds`` (900).

targets.rawSql:
WITH in_range AS (
  SELECT timestamp, cells::jsonb AS ja
  FROM social_movie_pixel_samples
  WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid
    AND movie_id = COALESCE(
      (SELECT movie_screening_movie_id FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1),
      '__idle_noise__'
    )
    AND timestamp <= NOW()
    AND timestamp >= NOW() - (($social_movie_heatmap_history_seconds)::double precision * INTERVAL '1 second')
),
strip AS (
  SELECT ir.timestamp,
         (r.ord - 1)::int AS row_idx,
         (r.cell_val #>> '{}')::double precision AS val
  FROM in_range ir
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ir.ja) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(cell_val, ord)
)
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 0) AS "0",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 1) AS "1",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 2) AS "2",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 3) AS "3",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 4) AS "4",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 5) AS "5",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 6) AS "6",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 7) AS "7",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 8) AS "8",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 9) AS "9",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 10) AS "10",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 11) AS "11",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 12) AS "12",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 13) AS "13",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 14) AS "14",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 15) AS "15",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 16) AS "16",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 17) AS "17",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 18) AS "18",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 19) AS "19",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 20) AS "20",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 21) AS "21",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 22) AS "22",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 23) AS "23",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 24) AS "24",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 25) AS "25",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 26) AS "26",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 27) AS "27",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 28) AS "28",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 29) AS "29",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 30) AS "30",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 31) AS "31",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 32) AS "32",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 33) AS "33",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 34) AS "34",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 35) AS "35",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 36) AS "36",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 37) AS "37",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 38) AS "38",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 39) AS "39",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 40) AS "40",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 41) AS "41",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 42) AS "42",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 43) AS "43",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 44) AS "44",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 45) AS "45",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 46) AS "46",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 47) AS "47"
FROM strip
GROUP BY timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp

options.content: The Atomic Cafe

panels.description: Screening progress (percent full when complete). MOVIE_SCREENING_DURATION_SECONDS in app/constants.py (60s).
panels.title: Screening progress

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT movie_screening_movie_id FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1) = 'atomic_cafe'
         AND (SELECT movie_screening_started_at FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL
    THEN LEAST(100::double precision,
      GREATEST(0::double precision,
        100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
          NOW() - (SELECT movie_screening_started_at FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1)
        )) / 60.0))
    ELSE 0::double precision
  END AS screening_progress
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.description: Fatigue for this title after a screening completes (+MOVIE_EXHAUSTION_GAIN_PER_PLAY per completion, same for all movies); decays per MOVIE_EXHAUSTION_DECAY_PER_SECOND.
panels.title: Exhaustion

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  LEAST(100::double precision, COALESCE(
    (SELECT exhaustion FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'),
    0::double precision
  )) AS exhaustion
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: Boredom Reduction
panels.description: Next screening boredom relief: boredom_relief_base from MOVIES, scaled by screenings_completed and exhaustion (same formula as game_tick).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  (
    (11.0::double precision / (1.0 + 0.45::double precision * COALESCE((SELECT screenings_completed FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'), 0)::double precision))
    * (100.0 - LEAST(100.0, COALESCE((SELECT exhaustion FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'), 0)::double precision))
    / 100.0
  ) AS reduction
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

targets.rawSql:

    * (100.0 - LEAST(100.0, COALESCE((SELECT exhaustion FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'), 0)::double precision))

panels.title: Loyalty Reduction
panels.description: Share of movie-exhaustion loyalty drain when combined exhaustion ≥ 50. MOVIE_EXHAUSTION_LOYALTY_DRAIN_PER_SECOND_AT_FULL=0.06/s.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(exhaustion) FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid), 0::double precision) < 50::double precision
    THEN 0::double precision
    ELSE
      (
        (LEAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(exhaustion) FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid), 0::double precision), 100::double precision) - 50::double precision)
        / 50.0 * 0.06::double precision
      )
      * (
          COALESCE((SELECT exhaustion FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'), 0::double precision)
          / NULLIF(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(exhaustion) FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid), 0::double precision), 0::double precision)
        )
  END AS loyalty_reduction
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

options.content:
Leadership

Community theatre

Routine compartment sweep

The movie screen above shows pure noise when idle or the clean screening clip while playing. Movie controls are to the right of the screen: interaction, screening progress, exhaustion, boredom reduction, doubt reduction, loyalty reduction. Screenings run one minute; boredom, doubt, and exhaustion update when a screening ends (catalog in app/constants.py MOVIES).
